The research facility did not submit their USDA fiscal year (FY)2025 Annual Report to the Deputy Administrator on or
before the extended deadline due date of 12/31/25. The annual report for FY2024 was also not received by the required
deadline. Research facilities that use or intend to use live animals in research, tests, experiments, or for teaching shall
submit an annual report, that covers the numbers of animals used during the previous Federal fiscal year, to the Deputy
Administrator on or before the December due date in this Subchapter of the AWA. Timely submission of the annual report
is essential to provide an accurate accounting of the total number of animals used and to ensure that professionally
acceptable standards governing the care and use of animals were followed during the previous Federal fiscal year
reporting period. The research facility must correct by submitting their USDA FY 25 Annual Report by the correction date.
CORRECTION DATE: 30 SEPT 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representative.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
Appeals sent by mail should be addressed to:
Deputy Administrator
APHIS Animal Care (AC)
U.S. Department of Agriculture
2150 Centre Avenue, Building B
Mailstop #3W11
Fort Collins, CO 80526-8117
